==Trivia==

* Maokai was named after his concept artist, [[Maokai Xiao]]<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://na.leagueoflegends.com/board/showthread.php?p=21953362#post21953362 Maokai Xiao, the Twisted Treant]</ref>.
** In Chinese, Maokai is rendered as  茂凯 / Màokǎi.
* Maokai's dance references the {{w|Harlem Globetrotters}}.
* Tabs for {{ci|Jarvan IV}} and {{ci|Lee Sin|'blindmonk'}} can be seen during Maokai's [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ejR2iOuPhEQ Art Spotlight].
